items.claim: Scene delta that throws in the worker is still acked as drawn
Worker layer visibility ignores whole-`scene` hiding, `defaultVisible` and `alwaysOn`
A hidden canvas shown again after its worker was released throws `InvalidStateError`
A worker stack whose second worker fails to start leaks the first
`snapshotStack` never closes the worker bitmaps it composes
`answerImage` stops waiting for the sharper raster when any image on the page lands
The client's warn-once set grows without bound
`hostSceneRender` has no teardown, and a second host takes over the realm-wide image loader
items.note: This was a behavior call nobody had made, so it is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: images are asked of each hosted page in turn, oldest first, and `hostSceneRender`/`serveSceneRender` now return a stop function. Its changeset is `minor`, because the return value is new API.

items.claim: Several gaps of the same kind: a frame whose overrides, scroll or resize threw also counted as landed; the worker now answers such a frame as lost too, and still applies its view, size and animator calls. It asks the page for a retry once, so a frame that is refused every time does not resend the whole scene every frame
